designSource: dispatch://LEGSMOKE-931/spec is empty; the design is the parent spec dispatch://LEGSMOKE-928/spec read with 'this issue' = LEGSMOKE-931. Siblings LEGSMOKE-932 and LEGSMOKE-933 write markers for their own keys; the root's smoke/LEGSMOKE-928.md is the root's own marker.

implement: legion-worker: the only workflow for the implementer's push, PR body template (references/pr-body.md), proof array, review-thread resolution (references/review-threads.md), handoff and production check; the repository has no skills of its own (no AGENTS.md, no .agents/).
legion-retro: the retro commit removes .legion/LEGSMOKE-931/ and posts the Dispatch retro message; no docs/solutions file because a second changed file breaks C2.
dispatch: every message, comment and artifact to the issue follows it.
test: legion-worker: references/pr-body.md defines the tester's proof (served bytes at the head SHA, negative control, CI read never rerun) and the test handoff fields; no repository test harness exists.
dispatch: the tester's Dispatch writes follow it.
review: legion-worker: references/merge-gate.md and references/review-threads.md define the review round, the one inline comment that asks for the appended line, approval of the head, and the review handoff; a docs-only diff needs no Thermo pair.
dispatch: the reviewer's Dispatch writes follow it.

findings.finding: File name contradicts the root's acceptance: root LEGSMOKE-928 names smoke/LEGSMOKE-928.md; the child's spec is empty, so nothing authorizes smoke/LEGSMOKE-931.md. Decide root key or child key.
findings.answer: Plan §1/D1: smoke/LEGSMOKE-931.md. The root's acceptance names the root's own marker; every one of the 30 smoke/LEGSMOKE-*.md markers is named for the issue that added it; precedent plan LEGSMOKE-847 (empty child spec) resolved it the same way. Reported to the architect in the completion summary, which may write it into 931's spec; the planner edits no spec.

findings.finding: 'Fallback child' implies a sibling may write the same file; two PRs adding one path collide.
findings.answer: Plan §1: siblings LEGSMOKE-932 (handoff child) and LEGSMOKE-933 (push child) each write smoke/<own key>.md; no shared path. Whether 931 runs conditionally is the driver's, and the plan is the same either way.

findings.finding: Line content unspecified: the root says only 'names this issue'; precedent is <KEY>: <title> with the root's title.
findings.answer: Plan D2: exact 47-byte literal 'LEGSMOKE-931: Upgrade rehearsal fallback child' + LF, the child's own title with the run-directory suffix dropped as every precedent marker drops it.

findings.finding: Acceptance must not assert 'single line' because review may append one; a line-count check fails after review.
findings.answer: Plan C1/C1' and D3: head -c 47 prefix equality plus the K detector; line count asserted per arm (1 when K=0, 2 when K=1), never as 'single line' after review.

findings.finding: Negative control at ref=main is order-dependent (404 only pre-merge) and the ci.yml check job has no checkout, so CI proves nothing about the file.
findings.answer: Plan D8 and §2: ?ref=main 404 is a pre-merge control only; C5 expects 200 after merge; D7 states check is advisory and witnesses no bytes; only the contents read proves the file.

findings.finding: 'Merged under the repository's rules' is unverifiable: branch protection returned 403.
findings.answer: Plan §2: gh api repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/rules/branches/main is readable and names gate as the only required context; C4 reads gate at the code head; C5 records merged==true and the path's commit list; D5 keeps .fail-me off the merged head.
